title: The choice that decides Roman Bellic's fate in GTA 4
subject: roman
description:
Deal or Revenge, which ending did you pick? 👇

One choice at the end of GTA IV decides whether Roman Bellic survives his own wedding. Spoilers for the ending of Grand Theft Auto IV.

scenes.text: Roman Bellic only survives his own wedding if Niko says no.
Near the end of GTA IV, Jimmy Pegorino wants one last heroin deal with Dimitri Rascalov.
Roman begs Niko to take the money. It could set them up for life.
Take the deal, and Dimitri betrays them again. At the wedding, a bullet meant for Niko hits Roman.
Refuse, and Roman lives. He marries Mallorie, and soon they have a baby on the way.
The man who promised Niko mansions gets his happy ending only if his cousin walks away from the money.
